headline: Week 5 player and touchdown predictions
method_note: Week 5 predictions use completed player/game stats through Week 4 only (nflverse weekly stats). Models are fit on 2023-25 and the locked 2024-to-2025 holdout gate (bust model Brier 0.1991 vs 0.2007 past-yards baseline, AUC 0.594 vs 0.570) passed this run; 2026 games feed rolling features only. Book lines never train or move predictions. No betting edge is claimed.

projection_freeze.leakage_control: Only completed data through NFL Week 4; no Week 5 outcome or book input.

sportsbook.label: FanDuel comparison only
sportsbook.note: No verified Week 3 Tennessee player-prop capture was available at this run; unavailable markets remain blank.
